# What changed — v0.12.0 to v0.13.0

**This is a FIXTURE migration, not a real one.** No real release ships a migration;
this file exists only so the upgrade-assay Verify table can exercise migration
selection, the dry-run, idempotency, and the release-note surfacing as written.

This section is the **human-readable release note** — the prose a person reads to
understand the upgrade, carried in the same file as the agent-readable `apply:`
steps above. `upgrade-assay` surfaces exactly this text as the release notes for
the span it is about to move, so an adopter sees *what* changes before consenting
to *how* it is applied.

v0.13.0 records an upgrade note in `docs/UPGRADING.txt`. The step is idempotent:
re-running it appends nothing once the note is present, and a `--dry-run` previews
the append without writing it. There is no rollback — a later move to an older
umbrella re-points and re-resolves rather than reversing this note.
